collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 5-9 and an adult)

collection.description: A child with palm leaf wings wants to fly from a small sand dune: count to three, or ask how birds do it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants to fly more than (subject.he/she) wants anything. (subject.He/she) has tied two huge palm leaves to (subject.his/her) arms and is standing on top of a small sand dune, about as high as a grown-up's knee, flapping. (friend) is watching from nearby, ready to catch, if that turns out to be necessary.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "One, two, three!" calls (friend). (subject) jumps. For one glorious moment (subject.he/she) is in the air. Then (subject.he/she) lands in the soft sand with a whump, leaves everywhere. (subject.He/she) sits up, covered in sand, eyes shining. "I flew!" "You did," says (friend). It was about one breath long. It definitely counts.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "How do birds do it?" asks (friend). They sit on the dune and watch the seabirds for a long time. They notice the birds never flap when the wind is doing the work; they just hold their wings out and lean. (subject) tries it. Standing in the breeze with leaf wings out, (subject.he/she) feels, for a moment, almost lifted.
